canonical_project: Doncaster / South Yorkshire AI Growth Zone datacentre proposal
owner: City of Doncaster Council; South Yorkshire Mayoral Combined Authority; Automated Analytics-led industry submission

location.country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

notes: Doncaster and South Yorkshire submitted expressions of interest to become a UK AI Growth Zone. Computer Weekly reported the council claim of 1.5GW AI processing capacity and plans for four AI-enabled datacentres in the region. This is an announced policy/investment proposal, not a named permitted site.
